original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳NAIMOS突袭非法采矿点 查获10台挖掘机
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳国家反非法采矿行动秘书处（NAIMOS）在阿散蒂地区阿丹西南区普拉河沿岸开展代号“水盾行动”的执法行动，查获10台挖掘机并销毁多台抽水设备。行动在New Edubiase附近的Adiemra和Tweapease发现大规模采矿活动，据报河流部分河段被改道、严重淤积并受到污染。

location.raw_text: illegal mining sites along the River Pra in the Adansi South District of the Ashanti Region, at Adiemra and Tweapease near New Edubiase

key_facts.fact: NAIMOS在普拉河沿岸非法采矿点查获10台挖掘机并销毁多台抽水设备
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) has seized 10 excavators and destroyed several pumping machines during an operation targeting illegal mining activities along the River Pra

key_facts.fact: 行动代号“水盾行动”，地点位于阿散蒂地区阿丹西南区New Edubiase附近的Adiemra和Tweapease
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The operation, dubbed Operation Water Shield, uncovered extensive mining activities at Adiemra and Tweapease near New Edubiase

key_facts.fact: 据报河流部分河段被改道、严重淤积并受到采矿活动污染
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: with parts of the river reportedly diverted, heavily silted and polluted by mining activities

uncertainties: 河流被改道、淤积和污染的情况为据报（reportedly），尚未获独立证实
事件目前仅有一个来源（MyJoyOnline），尚缺乏交叉验证
